Phase 34 plan submitted: docs/phases/arbiter-cockpit-30-arc.md (brief: docs/tagteam-3.0-proposal.md §4 Phase 34, §8 Q6). Branch phase-34-arbiter-cockpit; PR at the end; release 0.11.0.

Scope: (1) server hardening — ThreadingHTTPServer, loopback bind by default (`--host` opts into remote; called out as a deliberate safety deviation), per-run CSRF token in the served HTML required as X-Tagteam-Token on EVERY POST incl. the pre-existing ones, Origin/Referer check, no `*` CORS on POSTs; (2) read endpoints — /api/now, extended /api/rounds (entries/rulings/interjections), /api/interjections, /api/briefs + /api/brief/<id> + /api/brief/current (same rule as `tagteam brief`), /api/usage (aggregate + per-round churn series + rate-limit signal), /api/scope-diff/<cycle> (new programmatic `cycle.compute_scope_diff` extracted from the CLI, byte-identical CLI output; capped git diff), /api/tail; (3) SSE /api/events — signal-only `change` frames from a per-connection 1 s sampler (state seq, rounds count, interjections/briefs/usage max ids, pause marker, inflight), heartbeat, Last-Event-ID snapshot, per-connection threads with a cap (--max-sse, 503 above), polling fallback retained; (4) write endpoints as thin wrappers over the Phase 32/33 command functions (pause/resume/interject/retire/cancel-turn/brief generate/rule), by=web:<user>, {ok,message}, never a traceback; (5) frontend cockpit.html/js/css (plain JS, EventSource+fetch, panels Now/Inbox/Blockers/Feed/Diff/Usage, confirmations showing the exact CLI), Saloon kept as `?theme=saloon`; (6) schema v6 additive `rate_limits` capturing Claude's rate_limit_event from headless/briefer streams — the honest "subscription window" signal; (7) serve flags; (8) docs; (9) dogfood: this repo's `tagteam serve` during the impl cycle (live Feed, browser pause/resume as the hold, Usage over real rows), a scratch escalation ruled from the browser, two-tab SSE. Out of scope: hub, editing plans/rounds, auth beyond local token/origin, removing the Saloon.

Three open questions with recommendations: loopback default (accept as safety fix), per-run token (recommended), signal-only SSE frames (recommended). Please review against docs/checklists/plan_review.md.
